verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
There is only one thing I desire
There is only one thing I seek
To inquire in Your temple, O God
And gaze on Your beauty
I want to gaze on Your beauty

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You are holy, holy
You are holy, Lord God Almighty

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I'm looking for Your power, looking for Your glory
In Your sanctuary, in Your sanctuary
For in the time of trouble, God, You will hide me
In Your sanctuary, in Your sanctuary

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
I will hide, I will hide
In Your sanctuary, in Your sanctuary
I'll stand upon the Rock
That is higher than I, that is higher than I
